# Onis
Large, horned people that come in a variety of colors. Due to their unique eye structure they aren't able to properly aim most firearms and opt to hip fire them instead. Their physical strength brings them a lot of boons both in and out of combat.
## Diet - Nothing special.
## Benefits - Takes 15% less Blunt, Slash and Piercing damage. - Does more damage in melee; 20% more Blunt, Slash, and Pierce. - They're able to swing melee weapons 20% faster. - Due to their big size, they can easily carry, shove and pull any other morphotypes. - They are harder to shove. - Slightly more stamina than Humans. - They have an easier time prying open doors, taking around 50% less time than other species.
## Drawbacks - They have a 2x inaccuracy multipler on almost all firearms. - They are harder to carry and pull. - They are bigger than Humans, making them easier to hit.
